Package neqsim.process.mechanicaldesign.pump

Class PumpApi610DesignCalculator

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.mechanicaldesign.pump.PumpApi610DesignCalculator
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PumpApi610DesignCalculator extends Object implements Serializable
Value-only calculator for API 610 pump design screening.

The calculator evaluates process and purchaser data that can be checked without detailed vendor geometry. It does not certify API 610 conformity. Final casing, rotor, bearing, nozzle-load, seal, baseplate and test compliance must be verified against the purchased standard, project specification and vendor documentation.

Unknown vendor inputs are represented by Double.NaN and produce PumpApi610DesignCalculator.CheckStatus.NOT_EVALUATED, never a silent pass.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim

    • selectDriverRating

      public static double selectDriverRating(double requiredPowerKw, double[] candidatesKw)
      Selects the smallest configured driver rating that covers the required power.
      Parameters:
      requiredPowerKw - required driver power in kW
      candidatesKw - available ratings in kW; ordering is not significant
      Returns:
      selected rating in kW, or NaN if none is suitable

    • calculateBearingL10LifeHours

      public static double calculateBearingL10LifeHours(double dynamicLoadRatingKn, double equivalentDynamicLoadKn, double speedRpm, PumpApi610DesignCalculator.BearingType type)
      Calculates ISO 281 basic rating life for a rolling-element bearing.
      Parameters:
      dynamicLoadRatingKn - basic dynamic load rating C in kN
      equivalentDynamicLoadKn - equivalent dynamic bearing load P in kN
      speedRpm - bearing speed in rpm
      type - rolling-element bearing type
      Returns:
      L10 life in hours, or NaN for incomplete or inapplicable input
